title: What Happens If You Sneeze With Your Eyes Open?
description:
Closing your eyes during a sneeze is an automatic reflex, but with a lot of concentration you can keep them open, and they won't pop out. Each eye has six muscles, and a Texas A&M allergist says a sneeze is extremely unlikely to pop an eyeball out. The myth traces back to an 1882 newspaper story.
